title: From Accessible Learning to Career Opportunity

narration.heading: Accessible learning
narration.text: This sample lesson shows how an accessible video player connects learning to career opportunities.

narration.heading: Choose how to follow
narration.text: Turn on captions, open the transcript, and use the keyboard controls to follow the lesson.

narration.heading: Continue to opportunity
narration.text: When the video ends, explore the Career Gateway and share your verified learning certificate.
